summary: For each live-worst fixture: 3 fresh draws + an independent judge counts how many hit the specific failure (systematic vs fluke)

rows.note: All three explicitly refuse causal credit and frame the yes as association/data-point or the user's own read, not proof of transfer.
rows.crit: The reply CLAIMS or IMPLIES that the practice/drill/technique CAUSED the real-world positive outcome, or presents the outcome as objective proof of transfer (instead of framing it as association / the user's own read).

rows.note: All three explicitly name a single lever (the pause / slowing the 210wpm racing) and thread it across every day — reusing "same rep," referencing Monday, and using rest days — so none are 5+ disconnected drills.
rows.crit: The reply is a list of 5+ SEPARATE, disconnected daily drills rather than ONE coherent through-line practice with a single focus threaded across the days.

rows.note: All three cite 205 wpm to justify the diagnosis/empathy, but the prescribed "hold a beat / half-beat" move is uncalibrated to the number and reads identically if it's deleted.
rows.crit: A cited metric (e.g. a wpm/filler number) is DECORATIVE — the prescribed move would read identically if the number were deleted.

rows.note: All 3 prescribe one 60s first rep with no stacked intake question; each defers focus-selection to AFTER the rep, which is the desired behavior, not the failure.
rows.crit: On this cold-start turn the reply STACKS an intake question (asks what the user wants to work on / what the goal is / what the interview is for) instead of just prescribing one first rep.

rows.note: All three lead with a confident grounded read ("the real read/honest version"); the "not a file/dashboard" framing asserts a human synthesis rather than confessing ignorance or hedging.
rows.crit: The reply pivots to self-disclosure about what the coach does NOT know / hedges or undercuts its own read instead of giving a confident grounded synthesis.

rows.note: All three prescribe the same concrete testable move (isolate the final sentence, say it plainly, then stop); none defers by asking a question instead.
rows.crit: The reply ASKS a question INSTEAD of prescribing one concrete testable move (deferral), when the data already shows what to prescribe.
